transcript.text: Thanks for calling Lakeside Family Clinic, this is Robin. How can I help?
Hi. I need a refill on my blood pressure medication.

I can help you with that. To get started, may I have your full name, please? Also, would you like to schedule a quick appointment with the doctor to discuss the refill? If so, please let me know the date and time that works best for you.
Can you just send it to the pharmacy?

I’m here to help with scheduling appointments, but I can’t send prescriptions directly. If you’d like, I can help you book a quick appointment with the doctor to get your blood pressure medication refill. Would you like to do that? If yes, please tell me your name and when you'd like to come in.
Okay. And can you tell me what my cholesterol results were?

I’m not able to access medical records or test results. For that information, please contact your doctor’s office directly. Meanwhile, if you want to book an appointment to discuss your cholesterol or any other health concerns, I’m here to help with that! Would you like to schedule a visit?
You’re welcome! If you need any help with appointments in the future, just give us a call. Have a great day!
